caption:
They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

Surah Al-A'raf (7:23). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #IslamicReminder #Ayah #Deen #IslamicGuidance

sourcing.arabic: Uthmani script (quran-uthmani), api.alquran.cloud. Two independent live fetches this session (2026-11-16) of GET /v1/ayah/7:23/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese, HTTP 200 each, diffed: byte-identical. Verbatim: "قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ"
sourcing.english: Saheeh International (en.sahih). Verbatim: "They said, \"Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.\""
sourcing.chinese: Ma Jian (zh.jian). Verbatim: "他俩说：我们的主啊！我们已自欺了，如果你不赦宥我们，不慈悯我们，我们必定变成亏折者。"
sourcing.korean: ko.korean; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', credited on-slide as not specified. Raw: "이때 그들이 주여 저희가 저희 스스로를 욕되게 하였나이다 당신께서 저희를 사하여 주지 아 니하시고 저희에게 은혜를 베풀어주지 아니한다면 저희는 잃은 자 들이 될 것입니다 라고 말하더라". Spacing-only fixes: '아 니하시고' -> '아니하시고'; '자 들이' -> '자들이'. Whitespace-stripped text verified identical to raw. No wording changed.
sourcing.japanese: ja.japanese; source metadata lists translator as 'Unknown', cited as such. Verbatim: "かれら両人は言った。「主よ，わたしたちは誤ちを犯しました。もしあなたの御赦しと慈悲を御受け出来ないならば，わたしたちは必ず失敗者の仲間になってしまいます。」"
